subject: [hw] DONE DEC06 rev 3: HELLO version stays 1 (lead decision), geometry-change + NV12 paths tested; N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2509/2509
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 3. Supersedes rev 2. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit outside my owned files.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2509/2509
  T_NAL 675 + T_PIXELS 259 x2 + T_CLIENT 76 x2 + T_OBJ 158 x2 + T_OBJ 158 TSan + DEC05 adapter 3 + ios dylib/export 2 + ffmpeg decode 5 = 2509; ~40 s.

Changes since rev 2:
- HELLO version: my protocol stand-in now sends N2VCD_VERSION = 1 and accepts a daemon only when HELLO_OK.dec_codecs is non-zero, per opus-lead2 decision (a) ("N2VCD_VERSION STAYS 1u; decoder ids 20..29 additive, advertised via dec_codecs"; the encoder clients compare the version for equality). The stand-in is what a build without DEC05 client/dec uses; the product adapter goes through n2vcd_dec_* and inherits DEC05 handling. The t_client fake daemon now replies version 1, dec_codecs 3. If the landed rev-2 header changes the capability convention, tell me the exact check and I will match it in one line.
- Two object paths that were implemented but not covered now are: (1) geometry change (daemon answers changed=1: object drains, frees the pool, re-headers, re-adds and resubmits the same AU; asserts the AU is sent twice); (2) a daemon that reports linear NV12 instead of MM21 (same emitted pixels, no detile). T_OBJ is 158 checks per build now.
- No product behavior change otherwise; MM21 correction from rev 2 stands.

Not done (unchanged, full list in vt/dec/STATUS.md): no phone run / no daemon end-to-end; MM21 order verified against opus-mm21/libyuv but not on the phone; crop origin always 0; 10-bit/non-4:2:0/interlaced refused per frame with no nested software-session fallback; in-band parameter-set changes not tracked; CPU-side copy; setProperties/copySerializableProperties reply -12782; emit happens under the session mutex.

Files since rev 2: vt/dec/n2vtd_client_proto.c (HELLO version/capability), vt/dec/test/t_client.c (fake daemon version), vt/dec/test/t_obj.c (geometry-change + NV12 cases), vt/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md. All inside my owned directories.
